posts.title: Monitor a server with a dashboard

slides.text:
Monitor a server with a dashboard
Install a lightweight metrics agent
Point it at Grafana or your cloud metrics
Add CPU, memory, and disk widgets
Alert at 80% CPU for sustained load
Now you see problems before your users do.
